title: Cozy & Quiet 3BD Retreat Near Downtown Nashville!
description:
Discover your getaway haven! Nestled in a quiet neighborhood, this centrally located gem offers cozy comfort. With Interstate 24 less than a mile away, convenient amenities await. 

- Downtown Nashville - 18 miles 
- Downtown Franklin - 20 miles  
- Downtown Murfreesboro - 18 miles
- Percy Priest Lake - 5 miles 
- Nashville Shores Water Park - 16 miles
- StoneCrest Hospital - 4 miles

Your comfort is our priority. Book your stay now, and craft unforgettable Tennessee memories!

The space
Welcome to our 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom haven! With lofty ceilings upon entry, the home exudes openness and comfort. The main floor boasts a master bedroom and bathroom, conveniently adjacent to the kitchen and dining area. Upstairs, discover two more bedrooms and other bathroom. The well-equipped kitchen invites you to create culinary delights. Each room features Roku smart TVs for endless entertainment while enjoying the plush comfort of memory foam mattresses for a restful night's sleep. Your retreat awaits – a perfect blend of functionality and relaxation!

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire property with the exception of the owners closest.
